marketplace.description: Where these pages read the blueprint/operator catalog. `configmap` (default) reads the two indexes from the in-cluster ConfigMap the krateo-marketplace-catalog composition renders, in the release namespace; `external` fetches the Helm-repo index through the blueprints-endpoint Secret, also in the release namespace. MUST match the portal chart's marketplace.source — both read the same catalog.

configMapName.description: Name of the catalog ConfigMap, read in the release namespace.
configMapName.title: configMapName

liveIndex.description: Also read the live blueprints index so a freshly published blueprint appears before the catalog ConfigMap is re-released.
liveIndex.title: liveIndex

marketplace.title: marketplace

namespace.description: The namespace this chart CREATES and installs its page objects into. It is the RBAC boundary the whole chart exists for — a group with no RoleBinding here cannot `list` the page roots, so the portal's sidebar never shows them and the page body 403s on a deep link. The release itself stays wherever the composition is created (krateo-system on the platform install); only the page objects live here.
namespace.title: namespace

readerGroups.description: Groups granted read of these pages in `namespace`. A group listed here sees /marketplace in the sidebar and can open it; a group absent cannot list the page roots, so the entry never renders. `devs` is deliberately NOT a default — keeping it out is the point of the split (#261). No schema default: the installer applies schema defaults, so one here would silently re-assert itself over a group set through componentValues. The chart default lives in values.yaml instead.
readerGroups.title: readerGroups
